mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refunds (id, tenant_key, external_refund_id, external_payment_id, external_customer_id, amount, currency, status, occurred_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (COALESCE(#{id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), #{tenantKey}, #{externalRefundId}, #{externalPaymentId}, #{externalCustomerId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{occurredAt}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectKey}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now())) ON CONFLICT (external_refund_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, amount = EXCLUDED.amount, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_key, external_refund_id, external_payment_id, external_customer_id, amount, currency, status, occurred_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM refunds WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_refund_id, external_payment_id, external_customer_id, amount, currency, status, occurred_at, subject_type, subject_key, created_at, updated_at FROM refunds WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_key, external_refund_id, external_payment_id, external_customer_id, amount, currency, status, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at FROM refunds WHERE external_refund_id = #{externalRefundId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_key, external_refund_id, external_payment_id, external_customer_id, amount, currency, status, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at FROM refunds WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds
AND tenant_key = #{tenantKey}
